summary: The proposed two-heavy pointwise radial comparison E exp(-a||sqrt(12)VX+G_(I-VV^T)||^2)<=(1+2a)^(-1) is false even for iid centered unit intervals and V=[[1/sqrt2,1/sqrt2],[0,0]]. With kappa=12a, the comparison reduces exactly to sqrt(2pi/kappa)erf(sqrt(kappa/2))-(2/kappa)(1-e^(-kappa/2)) <= (1+kappa/6)^(-1/2), whose left/right leading constants are sqrt(2pi) and sqrt6; an explicit rigorous violation occurs at kappa=10000. This refutes only the pointwise Gaussian-Laplace extension. The same run proves the orthogonal same-sign two-heavy central no-escape theorem; the full QFORM target remains open.
replacement_obligation: Use an integrated half-Riesz/two-heavy comparison retaining the s-weight, rather than pointwise radial Gaussian domination.
